scope: Configured independent backend environments/models survive ordinary primary-app retirement; embedded configured backends block unsafe runtime replacement.
final_selection: Ten new cases, ten existing native alias cases, five shared/user-data guards, fifteen removal/lease controls and four existing explicit-purge controls. Nine unchanged translated-refusal cases explicitly deselected; no caption or localization behavior changes.
runtime: Actual Linux disposable filesystem and real symlinks; fake old app/backend interpreter bytes are never executed. No backend installation, download, package manager, account, network or physical GPU operation.
limits: Independent backend software/runtime and model bytes are configured persistent content, not merely an undifferentiated cache.
Unconfigured software under the retiring primary runtime is still removed; explicit opt-in purge keeps its existing deletion policy.
No whole N703, full CI or release acceptance.
